notes.title: Halloween 2021
notes.content:
Next on our busy schedule is the start of the real deal, PvP. First up is 1 on 1 and our first closed beta-test was successful, however the netcode we used only worked on LAN so back to square one one that one. Thanks for believing in us and keep your patience, PvP is at least few months away, but we will get there.

Happy Halloween all!
-Jonas and Micke from the Dev team.
